A <c:ffff00>sub-skill<c> for <c:ffff00>ranged<c> attacks that hits the chosen
<c:ffff00>{{slot}}<c>.
After choosing the <c:ffff00>{{target}}<c>, you can pick the <c:ffff00>{{part}}<c>, but
<c:ffff00>{{prep}}<c> drops by 50%.
<c:ffff00>{{success_power}}<c> drops and <c:ffff00>{{attack_failure}}<c> is likelier by
{{slot}} (most for arms, least for the head), easing with
each <c:ffff00>destroyed<c> {{slot}} of the {{opponent}}.
On success, the {{opponent}} can't <c:ffff00>respond<c> and the
chosen {{part}} takes <c:ffff00>{{damage}}<c>.
